title: The World's Biggest Iceberg Just Vanished After 40 Years

scenes.text: The world's biggest iceberg just vanished.
It was called A23a, and it broke off Antarctica in 1986.
At first it weighed close to a trillion tons, with twice the area of London.
It sat stuck on the seabed for years, then started drifting in 2020.
In January 2026, NASA saw blue meltwater pooling on top, a sign it was falling apart.
By mid-2026, a forty-year-old giant had broken into pieces and gone.

description:
The world's biggest iceberg just vanished.
A23a broke off Antarctica in 1986, weighed close to a trillion tons and covered about 4,000 square kilometres at first. In January 2026 NASA saw meltwater pooling on top, and by mid-2026 it had broken apart.
What would you have named it? Comment below.
first_comment: It stayed stuck for years, then drifted for about five. Would you have liked to see it up close?
